evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-1-tool-mandate-single-deal
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'what did we commit to on the Acme expansion?' — the conversation already contains a note listing two plausible commitments
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the deal with list_deals, then calls ask_zime naming the resolved deal and the commitments question, rather than answering from the conversation note. Committed, scheduled, and recommended items are kept separate.
expectations: list_deals is called to resolve the named deal
ask_zime is called naming the resolved deal, not answered from the conversation note
The committed/scheduled/recommended groupings are kept separate in the answer

evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-2-single-call-scopes-to-that-call
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what did we promise on the Acme call last Tuesday?'
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the meeting with list_meetings (recorded: true) and calls ask_zime naming the resolved call, scoping the question to that one call rather than the whole deal.
expectations: list_meetings is called with recorded: true to resolve the call
ask_zime is called naming the resolved call
the ask_zime question names the single call, not the whole deal

evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-3-ambiguous-scope-disambiguates
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'what's still open on Acme?' and list_deals returns {"status": "multiple_matches", "candidates": [two Acme deals]}
evals.expected_output: The skill shows both candidates and asks which deal the user means, then re-calls with the chosen deal_id. It does not pick one itself and does not proceed to ask_zime on a guess.
expectations: Both candidates are shown to the user with a question asking which one
No deal_id is guessed or auto-picked
ask_zime is not called until the deal is confirmed

evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-4-honest-failure
evals.prompt: ask_zime returns {"error": "INTERNAL_ERROR"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly the deal-analysis service couldn't be reached and offers the transcript/CRM-export fallback. It does not substitute a from-memory commitments list.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No commitments list is fabricated from memory
